svg.title: Native pixel drawing guide / 128px / flat
svg.desc: NW8-NE4-SW2-SE1-v1; row-major 5,11,3,2,7,15,14,9,12,13,10,4,1,6,8,0. Integer pixel runs, opaque palette and transparent sea. Hide reference layers before importing your artwork. Thickness quantized to whole pixels; labels omitted below 16px. No real height or overhang.
